title: Marvel: Characters Sets & SV Battlers (Avengers, Spider-Man, X-Men, & More) [UPDATED 1/4/2026]

posts.author: GalacticGod
posts.body:
I have been reading Marvel Comics since I was very young and it is my pleasure to present my version of many of their characters, including: The Avengers, Spider-Man, Captain America, Captain Marvel, The X-Men, Fantastic Four, the Netflix Defenders, and many, many, many other characters. Some of the sprites are based off of their comic book attire, and some are based off of their movie counter-parts (There really is no rhyme or reason to it; it's just whatever version I felt like creating). Enjoy!
Terms of Use & Credit
Credit:
Characters were created using the base MV characters and clothing that comes from the Kadokawa RPG Maker MV character packs. Some character eyes and other parts were created with the help of different generated materials provided by the community; (Contributions are credited in the sprite sheet they were used in).
Non-Commercial:
(Should only be used in a fan game)
Commercial:
Not-Allowed
Repost:
Yes (a link back to this thread would be nice)
Edits:
Allowed (a link back to this thread would be nice)
Repost of Edits:

Maker Required:
RPG Maker MV
Note:
Still pretty new at this so if I did something wrong or credited incorrectly, or missed a credit to someone; please just let me know so I can fix it.

!!!! This is incredible! How did I never see this before?
First of all, it's great to see a fellow True Believer on these boards, especially one who's such an incredible artist!
All these sprites (much like Spider-Man) are AMAZING! It's quite surreal to see these characters in the RTP style. The Symbiote Suit Spidey (very difficult to nail the shading on that costume without making it look like just a black blob, and you did it!), the whole FF (do I spot some live-action influence on The Thing? Reed, Sue, & Johnny look great as well- the line-less body of the Torch with the fiery aura calls to mind an 80s artist, although I can't remember which off the top of my head. his bulky modern design from the 2011 series

Logan needs his claws to fight- although I realize this is ultimately a minor complaint and borne out of the limits of the spritesheet poses.) all jump out at me as being great representations of the Marvel characters. It's great to see someone doing art like this of the characters' classic comic designs. Your MCU sheets are superior as well!
Although I can't think of a situation where I myself could use these short of getting a surprise phone call from the House of Ideas, these spritesheets made my day.

posts.author: GalacticGod
posts.body:
I have a deep love and passion for comics, especially Marvel comics from the late 80's / early 90's. It was a special time of my childhood. I first started making Marvel sprites as a way to learn how to make sprites for my traditional RPG games but it quickly turned into a passion project to try and create as many/all of the Marvel character sprites as I could.
Thank you for coming on this journey with me.
I have a bunch of my comic sprites up on my itch page. I am guessing that is the place I will post future updates on them.
GalacticGod - itch.io
I have loved being a part of the community here. I hope to see some you there on others sites and discord channels.
Thank you to everyone.
I'm going to miss this place.
